proof_body:
by
  intro A _ h
  have h2 : ∀ x : A, x + x = 0 := by
    intro x
    have := h (x + x)
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, h x] at this
    have h3 : x + x + (x + x) = (x + x) + 0 := by rw [add_zero]; exact this
    exact add_left_cancel h3
  refine ⟨h2, fun x y => ?_⟩
  have := h (x + y)
  simp only [add_mul, mul_add, h x, h y] at this
  have h4 : x * y + y * x = 0 := by
    have h5 : x + (x * y + y * x) + y = x + 0 + y := by rw [add_zero]; rw [← this]; abel
    exact add_left_cancel (add_right_cancel h5)
  have h6 := h2 (x * y)
  exact add_left_cancel (h6.trans h4.symm)
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [Ring A], (∀ x : A, x * x = x) → (∀ x : A, x + x = 0) ∧ ∀ x y : A, x * y = y * x
